review_evidence: README identifies a Lean formalization of combinatorial game theory covering general games, specific games, nimbers, surreal numbers, and associated algebra/order theory.

The primary tree directly implements game order/classes, impartial and loopy games, Nim and Domineering, nimber field theory, surreal arithmetic/Hahn-series material, sign expansions, tactics, and supporting Mathlib lemmas.
The isolated Test/GameCmp module belongs to a formal tactic-development surface and is not safely removable by its path; no lossless primary exclusion was established.
summary: Retain the complete combinatorial-games formalization, including tactic/test material tied to the game theory development.
